rules.expert_info: USA Volleyball rules are the standard for our club. Key areas include service order, Libero transitions, and net contact rules.

faqs.q: What is the cost of tryouts?
Where do I sign in for tryouts?
faqs.a: Check-in and sign-in occur at our main facility located at 6910 Stroop Ln, Smyrna, TN 37167 (Hooptown). Please arrive 30 minutes early.

faqs.q: When will we know team placements?
faqs.a: Offers are sent via email within 48-72 hours after the tryout session for your age group.

faqs.q: What do I need to be ready for?
faqs.a: Athletes should bring water, knee pads, and court shoes, and be ready for physical testing and agility drills followed by skill evaluations.
